shortDescription: 按页读取 PDF 文档、提取文本，支持附件和已保存到工作区的文件。
capabilitySummary: Read an existing PDF document as a paged text view. Extract text from papers and reports attached or downloaded as files in the selected workspace.

tools.description: Read existing PDF files in the selected workspace and extract their text by page; this tool takes a local path, not a URL. Pages are 1-indexed; each call returns up to 50 pages and 128 KiB of text from a file up to 16 MiB. Use the returned page range and truncation flags to continue with a smaller range when needed. Scanned page images require a separate visual or OCR workflow.

path.description: Path from the selected workspace binding: use the attachment’s logical path or the verified relative path of an existing PDF file.

endPage.description: Inclusive last page. Omit to read toward the end within the per-call page and output limits.

promptContribution.promptSnippet: Read page text from an attached PDF or one already saved in a bound workspace without installing a parser.
usageGuidelines: For an attachment, use its supplied workspace handle and path. For a PDF link, first obtain the file through an authorized download into a writable workspace; then pass its verified relative path, not the URL.
Use the returned page numbers and truncation flags to continue. Text extraction does not verify layout or perform OCR; inspect the relevant page visually when those matter.
